messages:
elaine: heads up — PR #3124 updates the Optimize toolkit page with new batching/caching guidance but I found two issues: broken internal link to SDK snippet and the quant profile table needs clearer defaults. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3124
raj: saw it, thx. which link is broken?
elaine: there's a link in the "Migration notes" section -> /sdk/python/batching.md that 404s (internal). also the Python snippet uses `client.optimize(..., quant='q4_0')` but we recommend q4_k_maybe; can we align?
tim: I'm on the SDK team. Quick note: we standardized on `quant='q4_k_m'` in v0.9.2. We should show both examples and mention tradeoffs.
sasha: can we just add a note: "Use q4_k_m for throughput, q4_0 for quality"? short and prescriptive.
raj: I can patch the link — looks like file renamed during nav refactor. Will update PR with correct relative path.
chris: also saw an issue with the caching snippet: missing `prefix_cache=True` param in the example. That causes folks to think caching is automatic.
elaine: good catch. please add `prefix_cache=True` and a one-liner explaining implications for latency vs staleness.
tim: for code clarity, use fenced block:
```
client.optimize(
  model="redwood-opt-13b",
  batching=True,
  batch_max_tokens=1024,
  prefix_cache=True,
  quant='q4_k_m'
)
```
That should be copy-paste ready.
docs-bot: PR #3124 was updated by raj with link fix, running CI.
elaine: thanks! If CI passes, can someone from docs + SDK approve? Quick review checklist: 1) link works 2) quant text is clear 3) example matches SDK API 4) add note about when to prefer no cache.
sasha: I'll do a docs pass later today.
tim: I'll verify snippet against SDK tests tomorrow morning.
chris: leaving a tiny nit: add a short migration note for Dedicated customers re: quant compatibility.
elaine: perfect. assigning reviewers: @sasha @tim. ping me when approved and I'll merge. :thumbsup:
docs-bot: CI ✅, all checks passed. (build/docs-site)
sasha: LGTM from docs side, small wording tweak on the headings, pushed to the PR.
tim: SDK check passed locally. approved.
elaine: merging now. thank you everyone — will follow up with a changelog blurb.
